node.statement: Dependency-gated positive-parameter application. This child requires validated node 1.2. Under the universal threshold e<=a_corr/(2*A_0), the e>0 branch has correction parameter a=A_0*e satisfying 0<a<a_corr. The amplified defect and unit estimates of node 1.3.1 and exact dagger preservation verify every hypothesis of node 1.2 for the same level-one map T, so validated node 1.2 yields one unital dagger-homomorphism mu_11 with ||mu_11,n-T_n||<C_corr*A_0*e=kappa*e at every n. The separate e=0 calculation in node 1.3.1.1 uses mu_11=T and needs no correction lemma. Consequently the complete e>=0 conclusion is available only after node 1.2 is validated.
